$comment: Declarative Kafka topic registry. The dev stack still has KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE=true so missing topics auto-create with KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS=3 defaults. This file is the source of truth for non-default settings (partition count, retention) consumed by the bootstrap script that ships in a later phase. Entries are sorted by topic name.

topics.name: inventory.events
topics.comment: 7-day retention. Partition key is product_id so per-product ordering is preserved (matters for the optimistic-lock invariant).

topics.name: payment.events
topics.comment: 14-day retention; money-events warrant a longer audit window. Partition key is payment_id (or withdrawal_id for shop withdrawals).

topics.name: shop.events
topics.comment: 7-day retention. Partition key is shop_id; doubled partition count vs other domains to absorb merchant-side fan-out (status flips, staff invites, sales aggregates) without head-of-line blocking.
